title: CGYBallers 2026 ALO Cup: 1-Day League
excerpt: A one-day league for CGYBallers members on Dec 6, 2026. 4 teams, 48 slots only. Registration is ₱300 per player.
body: CGYBallers is holding the 2026 ALO Cup, a one-day league for club members, on December 6, 2026. Slots are limited, so check the requirements below.
